SELECT * FROM ( /* 1. 상단 고정글: 1페이지에서만 노출 */ SELECT p.id, p.title, p.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, e.name AS authorName, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.posted_at AS postedAt, p.is_pinned AS pinned, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS commentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS attachmentCount, 1 AS sort_group FROM post p JOIN board b ON p.board_id = b.id JOIN employee e ON p.author_no = e.employee_no LEFT JOIN post_comment c ON c.post_id = p.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN post_attachment a ON a.post_id = p.id WHERE p.is_pinned = true AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.project_id IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, b.name, e.name HAVING #{request.page} = 1
UNION ALL
/* 2. 일반글: 페이징 + 검색 적용 */ SELECT paged.id, paged.title, paged.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, e.name AS authorName, paged.view_count AS viewCount, paged.posted_at AS postedAt, paged.is_pinned AS pinned, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS commentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS attachmentCount, 2 AS sort_group FROM ( SELECT p.id, p.title, p.board_id, p.author_no, p.view_count, p.posted_at, p.is_pinned FROM post p JOIN board b ON p.board_id = b.id JOIN employee ie ON p.author_no = ie.employee_no WHERE p.is_pinned = false AND p.board_id != 1 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.project_id IS NULL
AND ie.name LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'
AND p.title LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'
ORDER BY p.posted_at DESC LIMIT #{request.size} OFFSET #{request.offset} ) paged JOIN board b ON paged.board_id = b.id JOIN employee e ON paged.author_no = e.employee_no LEFT JOIN post_comment c ON c.post_id = paged.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN post_attachment a ON a.post_id = paged.id GROUP BY paged.id, paged.title, paged.board_id, b.name, e.name, paged.view_count, paged.posted_at, paged.is_pinned ) combined ORDER BY sort_group ASC, postedAt DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM post p JOIN board b ON p.board_id = b.id JOIN employee e ON p.author_no = e.employee_no WHERE p.is_pinned = false AND p.board_id != 1 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.project_id IS NULL
AND e.name LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'
AND p.title LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'

SELECT p.id, p.title, e.name AS authorName, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.posted_at AS postedAt, p.is_pinned AS pinned, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS commentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS attachmentCount FROM post p JOIN employee e ON p.author_no = e.employee_no LEFT JOIN post_comment c ON c.post_id = p.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN post_attachment a ON a.post_id = p.id WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND e.name LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'
AND p.title LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'
GROUP BY p.id, e.name ORDER BY p.posted_at DESC LIMIT #{request.size} OFFSET #{request.offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM post p JOIN employee e ON p.author_no = e.employee_no WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND e.name LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'
AND p.title LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'

SELECT p.id, p.title, e.name AS authorName, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.posted_at AS postedAt, p.is_pinned AS pinned, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS commentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS attachmentCount FROM post p JOIN employee e ON p.author_no = e.employee_no LEFT JOIN post_comment c ON c.post_id = p.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN post_attachment a ON a.post_id = p.id WHERE p.board_id = 1 AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, e.name ORDER BY p.posted_at DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.id = p.board_id JOIN project pj ON pj.id = b.project_id JOIN project_member pm ON pm.project_id = b.project_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_no = p.author_no WHERE pm.employee_no = #{loginEmployeeNo} AND b.type = 'NOTICE' AND b.project_id IS NOT NULL AND (b.deleted_at IS NULL OR pj.status IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED')) AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND pj.id = #{request.projectId}
AND e.name LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'
AND p.title LIKE '%' || #{request.keyword}::text || '%'

SELECT p.id, p.board_id AS boardId, b.name AS boardName, p.author_no AS authorNo, e.name AS authorName, p.title, p.content, p.is_pinned AS pinned, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.posted_at AS postedAt, p.edited_at AS editedAt, editor.name AS editorName, pa.id AS attachmentId, pa.original_name AS originalName, pa.stored_path AS storedPath, pa.content_type AS contentType, pa.file_size AS fileSize, pa.uploaded_at AS uploadedAt FROM post p JOIN board b ON p.board_id = b.id JOIN employee e ON p.author_no = e.employee_no LEFT JOIN employee editor ON p.editor_no = editor.employee_no LEFT JOIN post_attachment pa ON pa.post_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT b.id AS boardId, p.id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, p.status AS projectStatus FROM board b JOIN project p ON p.id = b.project_id JOIN project_member pm ON pm.project_id = p.id WHERE pm.employee_no = #{loginEmployeeNo} AND b.type = 'NOTICE' AND b.project_id IS NOT NULL AND (b.deleted_at IS NULL OR p.status IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED')) ORDER BY p.name

SELECT b.id AS boardId, p.id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, p.status AS projectStatus FROM board b JOIN project p ON p.id = b.project_id JOIN project_member pm ON pm.project_id = p.id WHERE pm.employee_no = #{loginEmployeeNo} AND b.type = 'NOTICE' AND b.project_id IS NOT NULL AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELED') ORDER BY p.name
